due_when.clears_when: Two independent fixes, both wanted. (1) DOC: system-actions.md and the confirmation guidance must state that a run conclusion of failure does NOT mean the action did not run, and that the authoritative signal is the 'Wrapper exit code:' line in the run log — especially before re-dispatching any MUTATING action. (2) WORKFLOW: make the comment-back step resilient (retry on 5xx, and/or continue-on-error so a comment failure cannot mark a successful action red). Do NOT resolve this by making the workflow retry the ACTION on a comment failure — that is the double-apply bug this row exists to prevent.
